pr_body:
Overview
-----
This PR fixes #3576 by making all configurable properties of `Subject.entity` enumerable again. This maintains the original intent of #3231 while fixing the underlying issue that it introduced.

**Note:** Unfortunately, I didn't noticed #3656 until just before opening this PR. That being said, I think that these changes are still worth proposing since they take a different approach and include tests.

-----

@pleerock Please let me know if the impact of these changes are larger than I'm anticipating. As far as I can tell, this makes the properties on `Subject.entity` the same as they were prior to #3231.
pr_comments:
Hmm actually, it looks like there are still cases where the error occurs. Not only am I having a tough time reproducing via a test case, I'm concerned that the changes added by #3231 are affecting more areas than originally anticipated and that the benefits in this case don't really justify the risk.

@pleerock any chance we can revert #3231?
@vinsidious btw do you need entity’s properties to be not enumerable just like just like original author of #3231 needs? I thinking about pros and cons of them being not enumerable
@pleerock I never minded having the properties enumerable which is why I'd _personally_ prefer if we reverted #3231 so that I can update from `0.2.11` to the latest version.
